set.body: Introduce a root-first Field and ViewPlan representation instead of accumulating already-compiled SpatialOperator values. A view records its FieldRoot identity, current domain, target intent, selections, sampling policy, inverse policy, and inspectable plan metadata while sharing the root payload or source reference. Acceptance: smart constructors preserve domain and shape invariants; view composition allocates no field data and performs no IO; all derived views expose the same root identity; existing eager behavior has an explicit compatibility path; shared JVM and JS tests cover composition and invalid plans.
set.title: Spatial ViewPlan: replace pending operators with an immutable root-first view
